name.text: 句子类型对照
Sentence Type Contrast

description.text: 用于把陈述、疑问、祈使等句力放在一起对照；不是简单句/并列句/复合句的基本类型轴。
Contrasts sentence force (statement, question, imperative), not basic clause complexity.

name.text: 同一条主线可以换哪些说法
How One Learning Path Changes Form

description.text: 用于说明同一学习主线下，不同实现说法之间怎样切换。
Used to show how different realizations can appear within the same learning path.

name.text: 换档并列
Independent alternatives

description.text: 各成员独立画面，只保持画风和主角；不强制同场景，也不做成相反状态。
Independent pictures per member; keep style and lead character only. Do not force a shared scene or opposite states.

name.text: be 句怎样陈述、确认和追问
Be-State Sentences Across Statement and Question Types

description.text: 同一个状态，对照陈述、一般疑问和特殊疑问；换档并列，各壳独立画面。
The same state as a statement, yes-no question, or wh-question. Independent pictures.

name.text: 说明是什么状态
Say what state it is in

description.text: 说明主语处于什么状态。情绪形容词后可跟 to-inf（glad/happy/pleased/delighted to do），不按形容词拆 nid。
Say what state the subject is in. Evaluative adjectives may take an optional to-infinitive; do not split by adjective.

name.text: 肯定形式
Affirmative

description.text: 表示肯定、确认或直接陈述某事成立。

name.text: 陈述语气
Indicative Mood

description.text: 用于陈述事实、推断或一般信息，是英语中最常见的语气。
Used to state facts, inferences, or general information; it is the most common mood in English.

name.text: 主动语态
Active Voice

description.text: 主语执行动作，表达更直接，常用于清楚说明施事者。

patternName.text: 说明是什么状态
Say what state it is in

patternDescription.text: 说明主语处于什么状态。情绪形容词后可跟 to-inf（glad/happy/pleased/delighted to do），不按形容词拆 nid。
Say what state the subject is in. Evaluative adjectives may take an optional to-infinitive; do not split by adjective.

patternName.text: 确认是什么身份或状态
Checking Someone's or Something's Identity or State

patternDescription.text: 当场确认某人或某物现在是不是某种身份、状态或类别。
Used to check whether someone or something is a certain person, thing, or state right now.

patternName.text: 询问是什么
Asking What It Is

patternDescription.text: 询问现在是什么。
Used to ask about what it is.
